about: Task 12, chloramine mode, simulation only. Every number is total chlorine (mg/L as Cl2); model (a) is the free-chlorine grid and settings run on the chloraminated network (the conflation test). Rates are pooled over seeds from the sums in results_time_<net>.csv; a rate with no junction below the threshold (or nothing flagged) is null and printed 'not testable'.

settings.threshold_note: 0.5 mg/L total chlorine: a common utility operating target, not a California rule (California requires a detectable residual)

models.a: free-chlorine grid and settings (the conflation test)
models.c: chloramine grid, pH and Cl2:N prior (the chloramine mode's model)
models.f: best single grid member and dose (oracle)
models.g: model (b) on the first-order twin truth

acceptance_model_b_no_bar.about: model (b), uniform prior: the pre-registered bars applied for information only; they were set for model (c)

nitrification_sweep.label: literature thresholds, not validated; no bar
